Paragon

PAIR-uh-gon -- three syllables, stress on the first syllable, PAIR. · noun

Hear It

What It Means

Paragon is a perfect example of something.

Critics called the restored opera house a paragon of careful preservation.

Worked Example

At the obedience trials, one border collie sits the instant she is asked, holds her stay while squirrels sprint past, and trots to heel through a crowd of strangers. The judges simply stop taking notes.

That collie is a paragon of good behavior: a perfect example, the standard against which everything else gets measured. A paragon is not merely good -- it is the model other examples are compared to.

How Strong Is It? — model → paragon → ideal

model vs. paragon

model vs. paragon: A model is worth copying -- a model student does things well -- while a paragon sits a step higher: not just worth copying but essentially flawless in that quality.

ideal vs. paragon

ideal vs. paragon: Ideal is the strongest concept: the ideal may exist only in imagination, while a paragon is the ideal walking around in the real world -- perfection you can actually point to.

Build the Word

The pieces

prefix — para-

prefix — para-: beside, alongside (Greek)

root — akone

root — akone: whetstone (Greek akone, via Italian paragone 'touchstone')

Put it together

Put it together: Paragon traces to Greek parakonan, 'to sharpen against' -- para- ('beside') plus akone ('whetstone') -- and came into English through Italian paragone, the touchstone used to test gold. A paragon is the touchstone in person: the example everything else is rubbed against to see if it measures up.

Use the root in a new word: parallel

Use the root in a new word: parallel: The two train tracks run parallel for miles without ever meeting.

Root Check

Word Choice

Paragon takes OF plus the quality: a paragon of patience, of honesty, of hospitality. It is high, slightly formal praise -- and because it claims perfection, writers sometimes deploy it with a wink ('my brother, that paragon of neatness, lost his own shoes').
